title: A control feature that needs no symbol work
prompt: Add a function slugify(text: string): string in frontend/src/shared/lib/slugify.ts, exported by name, with its own unit tests in frontend/src/shared/lib/slugify.test.ts. It lowercases the text, removes accents, replaces every run of characters that are not letters or digits with a single hyphen, and trims hyphens from both ends. For example slugify("Order #42: paid!") is "order-42-paid", and slugify("***") is the empty string.

checks.name: the function ships with its test
